answers.core: This cannot be done with an add-on.
answers.workaround:
You can use the `offset` property as shown above or use a separate `offset` variable. But this is inconvenient because you get different cell coordinates for `TileMap` and `AStarGrid2D`.

In some cases you can use a simpler algorithm version if you can exclude negative coordinates. But this can be inconvenient when procedurally generating open worlds. This can also be inconvenient when implementing a chunk system.
